connectors.name: AnimeUnity
connectors.releaseNotes: 0.2.12: streams rebuilt on the literal-selection route (maintainer-piloted on this site): bare-text /embed-url -> vixcloud embed page -> window.masterPlaylist assignment (token/expires) + window.streams assignment (HLS candidates) with token/expires/h=1/lang=it appended - the pilot's HTTP 403 was the missing h=1 param. Requires Aroki 2.0.36+ (line-literal-assignment-v1, encoded-query-v1). Two server candidates; device playback not yet verified.

connectors.name: AnimeWorld
connectors.releaseNotes: 0.1.1: episode titles now show "Episodio N" (template over the source's own episode number - AnimeWorld does not publish real episode names server-side, and connectors must not invent data).
